topic: Peter Bala's OEIS A281428 COMMENTS conjectures 1–2 (displayed March 3, 2026; first entered February 16, 2026), and the accompanying modulo-385 and modulo-27 examples
title: Factorial bounds and sharp onsets for A281428: extending Su (2026) on Bala's COMMENTS, items 1–2

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: We extend Su's (2026) proof of Peter Bala's conjectures in OEIS A281428, COMMENTS, items 1–2 (displayed March 3, 2026), with factorial bounds and sharp onsets for the two accompanying examples. For a(n)=(2n)![x^(2n)]C(x), we prove v_p(a(n)) >= v_p((2n)!) for every prime p >= 5. The proof combines integral exponential coefficients with ordinary coefficients in Z[1/6], using the inverse cubic u-u^3/3=x. The exact eventual-zero onset modulo 385 is 6; modulo 27, the least eventual period is 18 and its earliest onset is 2. The same argument gives factorial bounds for every polynomial in the two differential-system solutions, including the companion A281427 and A052502.
summary: An alternative factorial-valuation proof after Su (2026), extended to polynomial observables and the A281427/A052502 companions, with sharp onset 6 modulo 385 and least period 18 from the optimal onset 2 modulo 27.
